task_title: check-deploy-test not-a-repo leg must not inherit an enclosing git repo from TMPDIR
task_criteria: scripts/check-deploy-test.sh: 'make check-deploy-test' exits 0 both with TMPDIR=/tmp and with TMPDIR set to a directory inside a git worktree (e.g. TMPDIR=/home/kara/.hermes/cache/scratch/oby-ob096 make check-deploy-test). The not-a-repo fixture leg either creates its fixture at a path where 'git -C <fixture> rev-parse --show-toplevel' fails, or asserts that precondition and SKIPs with a NOTE naming the enclosing repo found. The leg still fails loudly (adds a failure) if gate-deploy stops refusing foreign checkouts. Do not delete the leg and do not widen the assertion to accept the foreign-checkout message from a fixture that still inherits an enclosing repo.

Implementation scripts/check-deploy-test.sh:618-659: the NOTAREPO leg builds its fixture under the first candidate dir (/tmp, /var/tmp, $TMPDIR) where `git -C <candidate> rev-parse --show-toplevel` FAILS (lines 619-627), so the fixture never inherits an enclosing repo; if no git-free dir exists it prints 'SKIP: NOTAREPO leg not graded ... enclosing repo inherited: $inherited' naming the repo (lines 631-633); otherwise it re-asserts the precondition on the fixture itself and hard-fails if a toplevel is inherited (lines 641-646).
